title: chat-client message_query sort:None sends receivedAt desc; draft default is asc with chatId
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §Message/query: 'Default sort: receivedAt ascending when chatId is present; receivedAt descending when chatId is absent.' jmap-chat-client message_query (and Batch::message_query_get) inject [{property:receivedAt,isAscending:false}] when sort is None, so a caller never gets the server default; sibling clients omit sort on None. Preserved as-is in JMAP-ops7.20 because message_query_chat_id_and_default_sort and batch_two_pairs_reference_their_own_queries pin it. Decide: omit sort on None (spec default) or keep the newest-first client default.
